manholes.message.rusted_shut: It's rusted shut. You need a crowbar to pry it open.
manholes.message.pry_cancelled.released: You let go of the cover.
manholes.message.pry_cancelled.moved: You moved away from the cover.
manholes.message.pry_cancelled.hurt: Something hit you! You lost your grip.
manholes.screen.title: Sewer Network
manholes.screen.map_other_dimensions: Your other manholes are in other dimensions
manholes.screen.empty: No other opened manholes. Pry more covers open to travel.
manholes.travel.blocked.combat: You can't go down while you're fighting.
manholes.travel.blocked.riding: You can't take that down the sewers.
manholes.travel.blocked.cooldown: You need to catch your breath (%s s).
manholes.travel.blocked.not_in_network: That manhole isn't part of your network.
manholes.travel.blocked.too_far: You're too far from the manhole.
manholes.travel.blocked.cross_dimension: The sewers don't reach that far.
manholes.travel.flavor.1: Water up to your knees. Something moves in the dark.
manholes.travel.flavor.2: The tunnel narrows. You squeeze through.
manholes.travel.flavor.4: Somewhere behind you, a grate slams shut.
manholes.travel.flavor.5: The smell is unbearable. You keep walking.
manholes.command.no_node: No such manhole (use a node id, its short id, or 'here' within 4 blocks)
manholes.command.regen: Chunk %1$s, %2$s: %3$s rule rolls succeeded, %4$s manholes placed
manholes.travel.flavor.hatch.0: You climb down a creaking ladder into an old cellar tunnel.
manholes.travel.flavor.hatch.1: Roots hang from the earthen ceiling. You duck and keep going.
manholes.travel.flavor.hatch.2: Dust and cobwebs. Nobody has been down here in years.
manholes.travel.flavor.grate.0: Runoff gurgles past your boots in the storm drain.
manholes.travel.flavor.grate.1: Light falls through a grate above, then the dark again.
manholes.travel.flavor.grate.2: The drain pipe echoes with every step.
manholes.travel.flavor.cave.0: You follow the tunnels through the rock.
manholes.travel.flavor.cave.1: Water drips from the stalactites. Something skitters away.
manholes.travel.flavor.cave.2: The passage opens into a cavern, then narrows again.
manholes.travel.flavor.city.0: Concrete tunnels, flickering service lights, the hum of the city above.
manholes.travel.flavor.city.2: Graffiti on the walls. Someone else knows these tunnels.
manholes.command.setblock_failed: Can't swap the cover to '%s' (no loaded manhole there, or no cover block like 'manholes:hatch' or 'hatch')
manholes.message.home_shared: Home manhole shared with your team.
manholes.command.share_not_owner: Only the owner (or an operator) can change this home manhole.
